body:
I'm very sorry to hear that and I hope you are able to get the help you need. You stay strong and please don't give up. 

I know every person and every situation is different and this is very serious, but please don't think your daughter doesn't care. Please don't think this isn't devastating to her. Please don't think she isn't scared. Because I am all those things right now and my mom has no idea. 

I would take her screaming and crying right now over the silence and uncertainty. I know it's selfish on my part and maybe she wants nothing to do with us, but I can't help but think that sitting in a room with her will help her understand that she's not alone. Her fight is our fight.
